items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: They had Lillian Alpert, (phonetic spelling) an agency.

ctx.x: So I found a lawyer in New York and presented my case to him

and he filed the action against Nazarro for neglectment of management and the suit was filed at $150,000; and we had the trial and the Judge as more or less in favor for Buck and Bubbles, because Nazarro tried to prove that he taught Buck how to play the piano, so much that I didn't know how to do nothing and neither one of us knew how to do anything, he did everything. Therefore, he was making his case strong against us and him being who he was and what he was with all the witnesses he had to have against us in…

So however, there are two phones in the office, you see, two phones. One for the management and one for the secretary. So the lawyer found out about the phones situation and he went and got a brand new phone book and that's how he won the case. He come to court the next day with a new brief case with this brand new phone book in it. When he got before the Judge and presented his case to the Judge, plus the number in the phone book -- what it was the two phones showed up that this guy was conspiring in some way --…
